description.summary: This table details coverage for direct financial loss due to employee dishonesty or fraud, as part of a professional liability insurance policy. It outlines the conditions under which the insurer will indemnify the assured for losses discovered during the insurance period.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת אחריות מקצועית זו מכסה הפסדים כספיים ישירים הנגרמים כתוצאה ממעשי הונאה או חוסר נאמנות של עובדים, עד לסכום המפורט בתוכנית. הכיסוי חל על הפסדים שהתגלו במהלך תקופת הביטוח, ומתייחס למקרים של הונאה או אי-נאמנות, בין אם בוצעו לבד או בשיתוף פעולה. הפוליסה עשויה לחול על הלוואות ופעולות דומות, אך רק כאשר יש כוונה ברורה לגרום הפסד למבוטח או להשיג רווח אישי.

PART II
INFIDELITY OF EMPLOYEES
The Insurer hereby agrees to indemnify the Assured for direct financial loss including loss of money, securities or other property of third  parties  sustained  by  the  Assured  and  discovered during the insurance period as stated in the Schedule, through any act or acts of fraud and/or dishonesty  committed  by  any  Employee  of  the  Assured  working  alone  or  in  collusion  with others, whenever  or wherever the same was or may have been committed, to an amount not exceeding the sum in all, as set out in the said Schedule.
It  is  hereby further agreed that with regard to loans, including. Transactions in the nature of a loan  or  other  extensions  of  credit,  this  part  will  cover  only  those  dishonest  or  fraudulent  acts committed by an employee with the manifest intent to cause the Assured to sustain a loss or to obtain a personal financial gain, other than salary, fees, commissions and other emoluments.

טבלה: אחריות מקצועית - עובדים לא נאמנים
This table details coverage for direct financial loss due to employee dishonesty or fraud, as part of a professional liability insurance policy. It outlines the conditions under which the insurer will indemnify the assured for losses discovered during the insurance period.
ממדים: Specific loss scenarios related to employee dishonesty, Coverage details and conditions

PART II
INFIDELITY OF EMPLOYEES
The Insurer hereby agrees to indemnify the Assured for direct financial loss including loss of money, securities or other property of third  parties  sustained  by  the  Assured  and  discovered during the insurance period as stated in the Schedule, through any act or acts of fraud and/or dishonesty  committed  by  any  Employee  of  the  Assured  working  alone  or  in  collusion  with others, whenever  or wherever the same was or may have been committed, to an amount not exceeding the sum in all, as set out in the said Schedule.
It  is  hereby further agreed that with regard to loans, including. Transactions in the nature of a loan  or  other  extensions  of  credit,  this  part  will  cover  only  those  dishonest  or  fraudulent  acts committed by an employee with the manifest intent to cause the Assured to sustain a loss or to obtain a personal financial gain, other than salary, fees, commissions and other emoluments.
